templates.pat: ClinPGx annotates regulatory agency-approved drug labels containing PGx information. Read {{1}} about ClinPGx drug label annotations, the drug label sources, PGx Levels and the "tags" found in the table below. FDA, EMA and HCSC labels are annotated when found on the FDA {{2}}. Labels from other regulatory agencies were annotated as collaborations and are not routinely updated.
templates.zh: ClinPGx 注释监管机构批准的、含 PGx 信息的药品说明书。请阅读{{1}}，了解 ClinPGx 药品说明书注释、说明书来源、PGx 等级以及下表中所见的“标签”。在 FDA {{2}} 上可查到 FDA、EMA 与 HCSC 说明书时，我们会对它们进行注释。其他监管机构的说明书作为合作项目注释，不常规更新。

templates.pat: Lumping and Splitting is the process by which ClinGen curation groups determine which disease entity they will use for evaluation. Groups review current disease and/or phenotype assertions (e.g. OMIM MIM phenotypes) and select the included and excluded phenotypes according to {{1}}. MIM phenotypes represented below are those that were available on the stated evaluation date.
templates.zh: 合并与拆分是 ClinGen 审编组确定采用哪个疾病实体进行评估的过程。各组审阅当前的疾病和/或表型断言（例如 OMIM MIM 表型），并依据{{1}}选择纳入与排除的表型。下方列出的 MIM 表型是所述评估日期时已有的表型。
